The '''National Office of Statistics''' ('''NOS''',<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ons.dz/English/indexag.htm |title=Home |website=National Office of Statistics |access-date=13 March 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030206081828/http://www.ons.dz/English/indexag.htm |archive-date=2003-02-06 |url-status=dead}}</ref> {{langx|fr|Office National des Statistiques}}, ONS, {{langx|ar|الديوان الوطني للإحصائيات}}) is the [[Algeria]]n ministry charged with the collection and publication of [[statistics]] related to the economy, population, and society of [[Algeria]] at national and local levels.  Its head office is in [[Algiers]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ons.dz/index-en.php |title=Headquarters |website=National Office of Statistics |access-date=13 March 2013 |quote=Address: Rue Mohamed Belkacem, Oued Kniss, Ruisseau, Algiers |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090723110923/http://www.ons.dz/index-en.php |archive-date=2009-07-23 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

==History==
It was established after the independence of Algeria in 1964, and originally named ''National Commission for the Census of the Population'' ('''CNRP''', {{langx |fr| Commissariat  national pour le recensement de la population}}).<ref name="History"/>

In 1966, the office carried out the first census of the Algerian population after the independence of the country.<ref name="poste">{{cite web |title=4e Recensement général de la population et de l'habitat |url=https://www.poste.dz/philately/s/317 |website=Algérie Poste |access-date=13 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190813210521/https://www.poste.dz/philately/s/317 |archive-date=2019-08-13 |url-status=live}}</ref> Its missions, as well as its name, have evolved in parallel with the demographic, economic and social evolution of Algeria for which the office collects, processes and publishes statistics in these fields.<ref name="poste" />
